did: gate.py: added STAMP_SHAPE (\d{8}T\d{6}Z) and GIT_READ ('-c i18n.logOutputEncoding=UTF-8', '-c log.showSignature=false') constants beside BUILT_BY.
gate.py: passed GIT_READ to the rev-list listing and to both git log reads so the repository's log encoding and signature settings no longer change what is read.
gate.py: ended the revision of both git log reads with `--` (git log -1 ... <commit> --) so a tracked file named like a commit hash cannot make the read ambiguous and hide the build.
gate.py: required the stamp to match STAMP_SHAPE in _commit_build_problems, so a value naming a stamp in git revision syntax (x-g<hex>^{tree}) is 'names no run' instead of resolving to a tree.
gate.py: removed the _build_problems call from _release_problems so release reads the builds only once, through problems_check, and stops on its problems.
unsure: The stamp shape is matched at the start rather than anchored, because the existing passing test for a no-break-space suffix expects the value to be looked up as runs/<stamp>\xa0 and refused for a missing record, not as 'names no run'.
